skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the economic aspects of aquaculture and fisheries, including resource management, production, harvesting, processing, and marketing.
Develop and implement strategies for the sustainable development and management of aquaculture and fisheries.
Analyze and evaluate the economic issues in aquaculture and fisheries, and propose solutions.
Understand and apply public policies related to aquaculture and fisheries management.
Conduct research and analyze data related to aquaculture and fisheries economics.
Work effectively in teams to solve problems and develop strategies in the context of aquaculture and fisheries.
Continuously learn and improve knowledge and skills related to aquaculture and fisheries economics.
